WITH search_leads AS (
  SELECT l.lead_id, l.created_date
  FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.leads` l
  JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.campaigns` c USING (campaign_id)
  WHERE LOWER(TRIM(c.channel)) = 'search'
    AND l.created_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
),
flags AS (
  SELECT s.lead_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN b.booked_date BETWEEN s.created_date AND DATE_ADD(s.created_date, INTERVAL 29 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS booked_30d
  FROM search_leads s
  LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.bookings` b ON b.lead_id = s.lead_id
  GROUP BY s.lead_id
